Faq.title: Investor questions
Faq.subtitle: Product and waitlist transparency, in the same tone as the marketplace.

item1.question: Can I invest today?
item1.answer: Not yet. Equitty is on a waitlist. Joining is not an offer or a solicitation. Opportunities will open for qualified investors.

item2.question: Is this the same Equitty platform?
item2.answer: Yes. The visual language, asset classes, and screenshots come from the production marketplace: header, cards, filters, and Invest now CTAs.

item3.question: Is the referral code still there?
item3.answer: Yes. Enable the referred-investor option in the form and the code is validated with the same logic as before.

item4.question: What regulation does this sit under?
item4.answer: The platform is designed for El Salvador and the CNAD framework. The DASP license is in process; issuances will be private and for qualified investors.
